title: Frontend test harness for T5 click-to-reveal sanitization
description:
Threat-model T5 mitigation surface (design.md §9). The threat-model test suite (#39) ships a scoped-down T5 assertion (backend response is JSON-encoded so embedded \<script\> is a string literal) because the click-to-reveal + iframe-sandbox UX is owned by polaris-frontend.

**Scope.** Add a polaris-frontend test (wasm-bindgen-test or Leptos test harness) that loads a report payload containing \<script\> / \<iframe\> / external image URLs and asserts:
1. The content renders behind a click-to-reveal warning by default.
2. No auto-loading of remote resources.
3. iframe preview is sandboxed.
4. Image URLs go through a sanitizing proxy.

**Tests.** The corresponding #[ignore] in tests/threat_t5_malicious_payload_render.rs documents this follow-up.
